verdict.rationale: AngelList does run some automated behaviors, such as HRIS-driven auto-terminations and automated health checks, so asking about automation depth is fair for this platform. However, nothing in the evidence shows a way to version, review, or roll back automation configurations. Board-approved Equity Blocks and vesting templates are adjacent features and do not count as automation versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
